stemMarkdown: A can do a piece of work in 9 days. A and B working together finish it in 4 days. How many days would B alone take? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Together they do $\dfrac{1}{4}$ of the work per day and A alone does $\dfrac{1}{9}$, so B's daily rate is $\dfrac{1}{4} - \dfrac{1}{9} = 0.138889$. B alone needs $7.2$ days.
